Uncompromising Nutrition

Biltong vs. Commercial Beef Jerky

Why ambient air-curing creates a completely different biological and culinary product compared to industrial heat-treated beef snacks.

Comparison Biltong Bites (Authentic Air-Cure) Commercial Jerky
Meat Source 100% NZ Low-Stress Beef (Higher tenderness & low acidity) Bulk commodity beef from industrial lots
Heat Exposure Zero Heat (Air-dried with natural ambient airflow) Cooked in commercial dehydration ovens (>70°C)
Texture & Chew Tender, rich steak slices that melt naturally Tough, rubbery, dehydrated sheets
Ingredients Clean pantry ingredients (Coriander, pepper, sea salt, vinegar) Corn syrups, artificial smoke flavorings, nitrates & MSG
Young Enterprise Scheme

Our Story

We’re a team of four passionate 15 and 16-year-old student founders from Long Bay College in Auckland running Biltong Bites as part of the Young Enterprise Scheme (YES).

Unlike mass-produced jerky, we handcraft our biltong using carefully selected, low-stress meat. This thoughtful curing method yields pieces that are naturally more tender, less acidic, and richer in wholesome flavor.

Driven by teamwork, passion, and high standards, we take pride in delivering a clean, high-protein snack made right here by the next generation of Kiwi entrepreneurs.
